title_i18n.en: Huawei launches Flex:AI container technology, enabling a single card to host multiple AI workloads simultaneously.
title_i18n.es: Huawei lanza Flex:ai, una tecnología de contenedores de IA que permite a una sola tarjeta alojar múltiples cargas de trabajo de IA simultáneamente.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 华为今日发布Flex:ai AI容器软件，通过算力切分技术，将单张GPU/NPU算力卡切分为多份虚拟算力单元，切分粒度精准至10%，实现了单卡同时承载多个AI工作负载，并可聚合集群内各节点的空闲XPU算力聚合形成“共享算力池”。据悉，Flex:ai将在发布后同步开源在魔擎社区中。（财联社）
excerpt_i18n.en: Huawei today launched Flex:ai, an AI container software that utilizes computing power partitioning technology to divide a single GPU/NPU computing card into multiple virtual computing units with a precise granularity of 10%. This enables a single card to simultaneously handle multiple AI workloads and aggregates idle XPU computing power from nodes within a cluster to form a "shared computing pool." It is reported that Flex:ai will be open-sourced on the MoQ community upon release. (Cailianshe)
excerpt_i18n.es: Huawei ha presentado hoy Flex:ai, un software de contenedores de IA que, mediante tecnología de división de potencia computacional, divide una tarjeta individual de GPU/NPU en múltiples unidades virtuales, con una precisión de hasta el 10%. Esto permite que una sola tarjeta soporte simultáneamente múltiples cargas de trabajo de IA y agrega la capacidad ociosa de XPU de los nodos en el clúster para formar un "grupo de recursos computacionales compartidos". Se informa que Flex:ai se lanzará como código abierto en la comunidad MoDing tras su publicación. (Cailianshe)

Following the international success of their jointly launched AI glasses, Halliday, the new funds will primarily support the expansion of a more diverse range of "superhuman gear" (AI wearable products), with related new products set to debut gradually starting in early 2026.

Unlike approaches that aim to replace humans with AI, Gyges Labs is an AI wearable technology company dedicated to "enabling everyone to become superhuman." The company operates globally, with its headquarters in Singapore, software and AI teams based in Silicon Valley, USA, and leverages China's supply chain advantages, featuring unique technologies such as advanced optics and active AI.

Just as Iron Man and Batman's gear empowers ordinary individuals, Gyges Labs believes that applying AI to wearable products to let humans harness AI, rather than directly providing AI with limbs, makes humans more irreplaceable.

Luo Tingxia, founding partner of CanCan Capital, stated: "As a next-generation investment firm focused on technology and consumer sectors, we are committed to discovering and supporting companies that define the future. Gyges Labs perfectly embodies this vision. While the smart glasses industry is still exploring forms, they have already positioned themselves as the gateway to next-generation human-computer interaction through their forward-looking insights into 'invisibility' and 'proactivity.' Their team demonstrates exceptional product definition capabilities and pragmatism.
excerpt_i18n.es: Gyges Labs ha completado recientemente su ronda de financiación Pre-A+, con inversores Granite Asia y Brilliant Capital. Tras el lanzamiento conjunto de las gafas de IA Halliday, que causaron sensación en el mercado internacional, estos fondos se destinarán principalmente a expandir una gama más diversa de "equipamiento sobrehumano" (productos vestibles de IA), con nuevos modelos previstos para debutar gradualmente desde principios de 2026. Convertir a las personas en superhumanos podría ser el enfoque correcto para el paradigma de interacción humano-máquina. excerpt_i18n.en:
After over a decade of electrification in China's automotive market, and with Huawei's five "realms" setting a precedent, how will the Qijing brand, a deep collaboration between Huawei and GAC, carve out its niche? At the Huawei Qiankun Ecosystem Conference on November 20, Qijing provided the answer. First and foremost is product definition, which determines the brand's development direction. In this regard, Qijing's choice is to "have it all"—creating vehicles that are safe, stylish, highly intelligent, and offer superior handling. 

Simultaneously, amid rapid AI advancements, Qijing has set its long-term brand vision as "shaping the mobile intelligent entity." Unlike traditional cars that merely respond to commands, it will proactively sense needs through in-vehicle sensors and home IoT devices, using AI models to make autonomous decisions and provide services. 

01 A "Mini-Huawei" Focused on Mobility  
While the vision is ambitious, realizing it requires grounded efforts. To achieve Qijing's goals, Huawei not only empowers it with robust technology but also deeply integrates teams and processes, making Qijing essentially a "mini-Huawei" concentrated on mobility solutions. 

As the automotive industry enters the intelligent era, smart technology is key to differentiating products. Technologically, all Qijing models will feature the Huawei Qiankun suite, including Qiankun Intelligent Driving, Harmony Cockpit, Qiankun Vehicle Control, Qiankun In-Car Light, and Qiankun Vehicle Cloud. With the global tech community increasingly focused on AI in the physical world, the most critical component of the Huawei Qiankun suite is Qiankun Intelligent Driving.
excerpt_i18n.es: Tras más de una década de desarrollo de la electrificación en el mercado automovilístico chino, y con los cinco modelos insignia de Huawei ya establecidos, la marca Qijing, fruto de la profunda colaboración entre Huawei y GAC, busca definir su nicho ecológico. En la conferencia ecológica Huawei Qiankun del 20 de noviembre, Qijing dio su respuesta. Lo primero es la definición del producto, que determina la dirección del desarrollo de la marca. En este aspecto, Qijing opta por "tenerlo todo": crear vehículos seguros, modernos, con alta inteligencia y excelente manejo. Además, en la era del rápido avance de la IA, Qijing ha establecido su visión de marca a largo plazo como "modelar entidades móviles inteligentes". No solo responden pasivamente a órdenes como los coches tradicionales, sino que también utilizan sensores en el vehículo para interactuar de manera proactiva.

KTransformers, a high-performance heterogeneous inference framework co-developed by Converge Technology and Tsinghua University, has become the recommended inference engine for major models like Qwen, Kimi, and Zhipu AI on their launch days. Its engineering practices and compatibility have been adopted by multiple all-in-one product lines, making it a widely reused collaborative underlying framework by developers, manufacturers, and the open-source community.

Technically and ecologically recognized, KTransformers was successfully selected for SOSP 2025, known as the "Oscar of computer systems." It focuses on efficiently utilizing diverse computing resources such as GPUs, CPUs, and memory to enable large models to run efficiently on lower computing power and more flexible hardware architectures. Its paper, "KTransformers: Unleashing the Full Potential of CPU/GPU Hybrid Inference for MoE Models," was accepted into SOSP 2025, a top conference that has witnessed the debut of numerous milestone technologies like virtualization and distributed file systems over the decades, marking global top-tier recognition of its technical strength.

KTransformers, desarrollado en colaboración por Converge Technology y la Universidad Tsinghua, se ha convertido en el motor de inferencia recomendado en el día del lanzamiento de múltiples modelos principales como Qwen, Kimi y ZhiPu AI. Su práctica de ingeniería y compatibilidad han sido adoptadas por varias líneas de productos integrados, convirtiéndose en un marco subyacente colaborativo ampliamente reutilizado por desarrolladores, fabricantes y la comunidad de código abierto. Reconocimiento dual en tecnología y ecosistema: seleccionado con éxito para SOSP 2025, el "Óscar de los sistemas informáticos". KTransformers es un marco de inferencia heterogéneo de alto rendimiento, centrado en el uso eficiente de las GPU subyacentes.
